name: Chord Progressions: Staccato
source:
We join Eddy, Trent, Darrell, and Chester in the locker room after wrapping up their tense workout. Darrell and Trent feel their hearts being pulled in several directions all afternoon. Chester, wanting the best for everyone, now needs to delegate how he should guide them together.

[From [url=https://chordprogressions.itch.io/spark]Itch.io[/url]]
